note: Per-team neutral offensive fingerprint (pace, PROE, carry/target concentration) for the prop model's Phase-2 baseline anchor. Deltas are vs the season's league median. Ships DORMANT: readers fall back to league-neutral until wired + validated in-season.

provenance.source: nflverse play-by-play (REG); PROE = mean pass_oe on neutral WP plays (0.2–0.8)
provenance.carry_share: non-QB rushers only (team's primary passer id removed)
provenance.target_share: rank-based receiver target concentration (position split is a follow-up)
provenance.coach: modal head_coach per team-season from PBP; a change vs the latest season down-weights older tape
provenance.baseline: recency-weighted (halflife 1.5s) delta-vs-median over the last 3 seasons, mean-reverted (k=1.0), coach-change reset ×0.5

followups: position-split target tree (WR/TE/RB share) needs a gsis-id→position join
play-caller-name attribution (OC, prior-team sample) needs a curated caller map
wire current baseline into the scriptMult neutral anchor + role-share priors, gated on in-season CLV
